presentation.speaker: lena_park
presentation.title: First batch quality review
lines: The first production batch has recorded defects. Outsource a two-hour recovery slot or run two hours of overtime; both reserve real capacity and book actual production costs.

choices.label: Outsource the recovery slot
choices.detail: Outside production charges subcontracting costs per unit; your own materials remain in stock.
choices.outcome: A real recovery slot is reserved. Finish production and deliver the actual batch.

choices.label: Use a two-hour overtime slot
choices.detail: Keep production in your factory; overtime can worsen yield and pays extra technician wages.
choices.outcome: A real recovery slot is reserved. Finish production and deliver the actual batch.
